title: IoTSecFix fix records
description: One record per (vulnerability, fix commit) pair, tiers A and B. iotsecfix_fixes.json is an array of these; iotsecfix_fixes.csv has the same columns (lists joined with ';', booleans True/False, null as empty).

vuln_id.description: CVE id if one exists, else GHSA id.

ghsa_id.description: GHSA id of the project's repository advisory, or empty.

cwe_ids.description: ';'-joined CWE ids (NVD first, then GHSA); empty if none.

published.description: Earliest public date (NVD published or GHSA published_at), ISO 8601; empty if unknown.

parent_commits.description: ';'-joined parent SHAs; diff stats use the first.

pr_commits.description: For links via a merged PR: number of commits that PR put on its target branch (largest if several PRs). null for direct links.

change_scope.description: code: at least one changed file is product code; test: only tests (and docs/CI); doc_ci: only documentation, CI or dependency-pin files.

c_cpp_files.description: Changed files with a C/C++ extension (.c .h .cc .cpp .cxx .hh .hpp .hxx .ino).

fix_to_publication_days.description: published - commit_date in days; positive = fixed before disclosure.

link_sources.description: ';'-joined subset of commit_message, nvd_ref, ghsa_text, nvd_pr, ghsa_pr.

id_linked_to_project.description: The vulnerability's NVD references or GHSA point to this repo (false: only cited in a commit message, e.g. vendored code).
